info.title: API-DocTest-Replace Events Ticketing Tickets Transfer-v5-spec
info.description: The Event Ticket Transfer API facilitates the seamless transfer of event tickets between users. This operation allows users to securely transfer their purchased tickets to others, ensuring that the ticket ownership is accurately updated in the system. Typical consumers include event organizers, ticketing platforms, and users looking to send their tickets to friends or family members. By providing this functionality, the API enhances user experience and promotes ticket accessibility for various events.

put.summary: Transfer a ticket to another user.
put.description: This operation allows the current owner of a ticket to transfer it to another user. The request must include both the ticket ID and the recipient's information. Ensure you have the necessary permissions to perform this action.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to transfer tickets from one user to another. The request must include necessary details such as the ticket ID and the recipient's information to successfully complete the transfer.

200.description: Request completed successfully, and the ticket transfer was executed.
